Title: LR2 - ED-330 - RWC track prioritisation criteria
Text: The DAA shall use the following criteria to prioritize the tracks to be handled by the benefit of the RWC alerting and guidance: - Filtering based on range: Relative horizontal range <= 3 NM and absolute vertical distance <= 1600 ft (see appendix C, paragraph 4.2); - Filtering based on Tau Mod valuePriority is given to lower Tau Mod value.
